workspace.title: Workspace Manager
workspace.description: A Colcon workspace is where you write, build, and modify ROS 2 packages. Sourcing a workspace adjusts system variables so that ROS 2 can find your nodes, libraries, and launch scripts.

under_the_hood.description: Sources the primary ROS 2 installation to make core CLI tools available.
Builds workspace source packages. The --symlink-install flag ensures Python files and assets don't need rebuilding when edited.
Sources the newly compiled workspace packages to make them active.

tips: If packages are not appearing, click colcon build and make sure to source the workspace afterward.
Check that your package directory has a valid package.xml file.

packages.title: Packages Explorer
packages.description: Explores the ROS 2 packages currently compiled and active in your sourced workspace, displaying their dependencies and version details.

under_the_hood.description: Queries the active ROS 2 environment paths for all discovered packages.
Reads and parses the package.xml metadata of the selected package.

tips: Only packages in successfully built and sourced directories will appear here.
Dependencies are defined in your package's package.xml using tags like <depend>.

nodes.title: Nodes Monitor
nodes.description: Displays all active ROS 2 nodes currently running in the network. A node is a process that performs computation and communicates with other nodes.

under_the_hood.description: Queries the ROS 2 discovery graph for a list of active node names.
Fetches a node's active publishers, subscribers, services, and actions.

tips: Use the Nodes Monitor to inspect the inputs and outputs of individual nodes.
If a node is hung, you can select its card and click Stop/Kill to force-close its process.

topics.title: Topic Inspector
topics.description: Inspects active topics in the ROS 2 network. Topics are named buses over which nodes exchange messages via publish/subscribe communication.

under_the_hood.description: Retrieves the names of all active topics.
Gets message type, publisher count, and subscriber count for the topic.
Calculates the average publishing rate (frequency) of messages on the topic.
Subscribes to the topic and prints received messages in real-time.

tips: If no messages appear when echoing, ensure at least one node is active and publishing to that topic.
Verify that nodes are on the same ROS_DOMAIN_ID to see their topics.

launch.title: Launch Manager
launch.description: Visual builder and executor for ROS 2 launch files. Launch files allow you to start multiple nodes with custom parameters and namespace setups using a single configuration.

under_the_hood.description: Executes the selected python or XML launch file under the ROS 2 launch environment.

tips: Use the Visual Builder to generate standard .launch.py python files without writing manual XML or Python code.
Timer blocks are useful to delay node execution until core nodes (like controllers) have booted.

services.title: Service Inspector
services.description: Lists and calls active services. Services implement a request/response communication pattern, suited for discrete, short-lived actions.

under_the_hood.description: Lists all active service names in the ROS 2 network.
Retrieves the message type name of the service.
Sends a request with arguments to the service server and prints the response.

tips: Service calls are blocking: if the service server doesn't respond, the call will wait. The GUI calls services asynchronously to prevent UI freeze.
Arguments must be formatted as valid YAML on the input line.

logs.title: Log Viewer
logs.description: Displays and filters system and node logs from ~/.ros/log to assist in debugging runtime errors and warning logs.

under_the_hood.description: Reads and displays active log files incrementally.

tips: Use the Severity level buttons to filter out INFO messages and focus on WARN, ERROR, and FATAL logs.
Logs are cleared from the view locally but remain saved on disk.

troubleshooter.title: DDS Troubleshooter
troubleshooter.description: Diagnoses connection issues between ROS 2 nodes. ROS 2 relies on DDS (Data Distribution Service) for discovery and network routing.

under_the_hood.description: Reads environment configuration settings that restrict or configure discovery multicast.
Runs general network diagnostics on the ROS 2 system setup.

tips: If nodes cannot see each other, make sure they share the same ROS_DOMAIN_ID.
Ensure ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY is set to 0 if nodes are communicating across separate physical computers.

params.title: Parameters Manager
params.description: Inspects and modifies parameters of active nodes. Parameters are node-specific configuration variables (e.g. velocities, thresholds, ports).

under_the_hood.description: Lists all parameter names registered by the specified node.
Retrieves the current value of the parameter.
Dynamically updates the parameter value of the running node.
Saves all current parameter key-values of a node to a YAML file.

tips: Some parameters are read-only and cannot be changed after a node starts.
Use the Dump/Load features to quickly backup and restore configurations.

visualizer.title: Network Visualizer
visualizer.description: Renders a schematic network graph showing how running nodes and topics are connected to each other.

under_the_hood.description: Runs Graphviz layout software to compute node coordinates from a generated DOT syntax string.

tips: Ensure that 'graphviz' and its 'dot' tool are installed on your system PATH to render the graph.
The visualizer only displays active nodes. If your workspace nodes are not launched, they will not appear here.

bags.title: Bag Manager
bags.description: Records and plays back ROS 2 bag files. Bags store serialized message data with exact timestamps, allowing you to replay sensor data or logs for offline testing.

under_the_hood.description: Records active message traffic on selected topics into an sqlite3 or mcap bag.
Re-publishes recorded messages onto the network with original timing.
Inspects a bag file to show size, duration, message counts, and topics.

tips: When recording, only topics with active publishers will write data to the bag file.
You can adjust the playback rate (e.g. 2.0x for double speed) or enable loop playback in the options.

urdf.title: URDF Viewer
urdf.description: Inspects and visualizes robot model hierarchies defined in URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) or Xacro files.

under_the_hood.description: Converts macro-based XML (.xacro) files into raw URDF XML markup for parsing.

tips: Verify the kinematic chain links and joints inside the tree view.
Schematic rendering builds a 2D map of the link connectivity automatically.

tools.title: Tools Hub
tools.description: Central dashboard to check installation status and launch external ROS 2 tools such as RViz2, Foxglove Studio, Gazebo, and PlotJuggler.

under_the_hood.description: Checks the system PATH to see if the tool executable is installed.

tips: If a tool shows 'Not found', install it using apt (e.g. sudo apt install ros-<distro>-rviz2).
Sourcing your workspace is sometimes required for tools like RViz2 to discover custom plugins.
